extension.description: A dark, cinematic Kodi skin with glass panels, large backdrops and rows for Trakt continue watching, trending titles, your library and your liked Trakt lists (via Seren).
Een donkere, cinematische Kodi-skin met glazen panelen, grote achtergronden en rijen voor Trakt verder kijken, trending titels, je bibliotheek en je Trakt-lijsten (via Seren).
extension.news: 1.11.3: Profiles screen: the two top rows now have their text, profiles get a person icon. 1.11.2: Skin settings buttons open the right category (Seren > Accounts for Trakt, Seren > Playback, Kodi language settings) instead of the first one. 1.11.1: optional automatic subtitle search (A4KSubtitles) when a film or episode starts without subtitles in your language. 1.11.0: A4KSubtitles support: Search subtitles button in the player menu, settings and a Use as default button in Skin settings > Integrations. 1.10.0: pop-up when a new version of Lucent is available (Update now / Later / Skip this version), switch and Check now in Skin settings > Integrations. 1.9.10: add-on info page uses the full width in a glass panel, Automatic update switch no longer cut off. 1.9.9: colour swatch in subtitle settings (Colour, Border colour) sits on the right of the row. 1.9.8: System info screen tidier (each line in its own row, CPU/RAM/temperature as pills). 1.9.7: Calendar info text scrolls by itself when long, watched check stays red on the focused row, System info first tab says Summary. 1.9.6: wider Calendar, week cards no longer clipped, series logos in the week view, Up wraps around in Add-ons and library lists. 1.9.5: watched check marks are red, calendar buttons and week view tidied. 1.9.4: Calendar opens a series straight on its seasons in Seren (no search), week view spacing. 1.9.3: list view: the duration no longer disappears behind the watched check mark. 1.9.2: the Calendar now shows the series and films of your Trakt collection; the bell (off by default) gives a pop-up for a new episode or a digital film release. 1.9.1: nicer on-screen keyboard, Enter on a real keyboard now finishes typing, the Settings home screen wraps around. 1.9.0: new Calendar tab (Week, List, Month) for the series and films you follow with the bell on the info page, with a pop-up when a new episode is out (Watch now / Later; switch in Skin settings > Tracking). 1.8.5: Home rows and skin settings wrap around too. 1.8.4: Back stops the video, lists wrap around, Right goes to OK in add-on settings, trailers stop when you move on. 1.8.3: trailer video no longer hidden behind the Home background on CoreELEC. 1.8.2: trailers close the YouTube error pop-up and pause after repeated failures. 1.8.1: sidebar now says Lucent. 1.8.0: Lucent is now its own add-on (skin.lucent). On first start it takes over all settings, menu and widgets of Nuvio Arc.
